assertions.quoted_span: the Member State may lift the demarcated area after 12 months since its initial establishment
assertions.claim: The clock encodes bound='exact', but the source's 'after 12 months' creates a floor/not-before threshold, failing Kind and bound and the binding rule that 'after' is floor.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Set bound to 'floor' while retaining kind='eligibility_threshold', magnitude='12', unit='months', and the initial-establishment anchor.
assertions.falsifier: The source or a binding ruling establishes that lifting is eligible only at the instant exactly 12 months after establishment rather than from that threshold onward.

assertions.quoted_span: this demarcation may be lifted; the Member State may lift the demarcated area after 12 months since its initial establishment
assertions.claim: Both eligibility clocks use DEMARCATED_AREA_LIFTED as completion even though the source makes lifting a later discretionary act; their notes correctly say the threshold only opens discretion, so the executable completion fields fail Consequence and completion by pointing downstream.
assertions.proposed_remedy: End each eligibility clock on a record that its temporal condition is met—four continuous no-detection years or 12 months from initial establishment—leaving DEMARCATED_AREA_LIFTED as the consumer decision's result.
assertions.falsifier: The Stage B completion field is authoritatively defined as the later consumer decision that retires a satisfied threshold, rather than the act or state that completes the temporal condition itself.

assertions.quoted_span: Dopo 48 ore dal trattamento si procede all’estirpazione delle piante infette.
assertions.claim: The four not-before clocks end on whole treatment-and-removal sequence effects, but the quoted 48-hour temporal condition completes when 48 hours have elapsed after treatment, before the downstream removal, failing Consequence and completion.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Use an operator-record completion for the 48-hour wait having elapsed; keep removal or whole-sequence completion on the consuming procedure, not as completion of the wait clock.
assertions.falsifier: The producer text makes completion of removal, rather than expiry of the 48-hour wait, the event that completes the temporal condition.

assertions.quoted_span: Prima delle estirpazioni si effettuano trattamenti chimici contro il vettore nell'area interessata
assertions.claim: The clock is assigned to the broad mandatory-almond-removal producer and opens on PLAN_ONLY_EFFECT_APPLIES, while Stage A has a dedicated almond-pre-removal-vector-treatment row that emits CHEMICAL_VECTOR_TREATMENT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ALMOND_REMOVAL; the current completion is that requirement token rather than performance of treatment, so producer, anchor, and completion do not express the real treatment moment.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Use PUG-DGR1075-2025:§4.3.2:almond-pre-removal-vector-treatment:v1 as producer, open the ordering constraint on its treatment-required result subject to its exception branch, and complete it on the operator's treatment-performed record before removal.
assertions.falsifier: The dedicated Stage A almond-pre-removal-vector-treatment row is not the producer of this temporal relation, or its CHEMICAL_VECTOR_TREATMENT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ALMOND_REMOVAL effect denotes completed treatment rather than activation of the duty.

assertions.row: B-PAR-EU-2(4)-v2-C80-p1; B-PAR-EU-10-sub1-C90-p0.5; B-PAR-EU-10-sub2-C90-p1; B-PAR-EU-15(2)-final-C90-p0.7; B-PAR-EU-15(4)-C90-p1; B-PAR-EU-5(1)(c)-v2-C90-p1; B-PAR-EU-5(4)-sub1-C90-p1; B-PAR-EU-6(2)(b)-C95-p1; B-PAR-EU-6(3)-C80-p1
assertions.quoted_span: with at least 90 % confidence a level of presence of infected plants of 0,5 %
assertions.claim: All nine Union design-target parameters set comparator=null even though each quote makes confidence a floor ('at least') while design prevalence is the stated detection level, so the composite value loses the legal comparator and fails Magnitude, unit, comparator.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Represent the composite relation explicitly, with confidence comparator '>=' and the stated design-prevalence relation, for each Union confidence/prevalence pair; do not rely on prose or kind='design_target' to imply the floor.
assertions.falsifier: The canonical schema's binding definition of kind='design_target' explicitly and unambiguously defines every confidence component as a minimum and every design-prevalence component with the source-stated relation.

assertions.claim: The row uses unit='days', which does not preserve the binding calendar distinction: Q5 requires calendar_days when a source says unqualified days, so the unit fails Magnitude, unit, comparator.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Set unit to 'calendar_days' unless a source span establishes working days.
assertions.falsifier: A binding Stage B convention explicitly defines unit='days' as the canonical alias for calendar_days.

checked_sound: Exhaustively reread all 67 clocks against their producer Stage A rows and source_quote spans, in clock order, covering anchor denotation; legal-state object, medium and place; kind/bound; magnitude/unit/relation/window/applies_when; consequence; completion; intervals; and vocabulary.

Exhaustively reread all 13 floor, one ceiling, and four threshold parameters; the 50 m, 400 m, 1 km, 2 km, 2.5 km, and 5 km geometries preserve their quoted magnitudes and inclusive floor/ceiling relations, and the island exemption correctly preserves the strict '> 5 km' comparator.

Checked every design_target row and every distinct confidence/prevalence pair: the numeric values and scopes match their quotes, including EU 90%/0.5%, 90%/0.7%, 90%/1%, 95%/1%, 80%/1%, and the nine PNI 2026 target/stratum rows after exact proportion-to-percent normalization; the surviving issue is the missing Union confidence comparator reported above.
The Article 2(1) version split is source-faithful: v1 is host plants only, while v2 adds other plant species on suspicion and optional vector coverage without back-projecting them.

The Article 4(1) anchors correctly distinguish the pre-M5 source with no stated medium from the post-M5 plant-only trigger, and the L.R. 4 Article 3(3) modification anchor correctly names the specified pest in a plant in the buffer zone.

The Article 5(4)(a) clocks preserve the two-year to one-year Union version change, split minimum duration from annual recurrence, and keep the national second-year requirements in their own producer intervals.

The Article 7(1)(e) clocks are correctly per-plant: immediate sampling begins when the specified plant enters the eradication infected zone, the v1/v2 negative-test difference is not back-projected, and the two-year history is a decision-time lookback rather than a forward clock.

The Article 8(1), 13(1)-sub1, and 14(1) rows preserve ordering and mutually exclusive flight-season alternatives without inventing numeric deadlines; immediately/without delay/tempestivamente remain indefinite promptness standards.

The four DDS 31/DDS 45 treatment-to-removal rows correctly preserve magnitude 48 hours, floor/not_before semantics, treatment-event anchors, and procedure-version intervals; only their downstream completion target is reported as defective.
The Cq parameters preserve <32 positive and >35 negative comparators and leave the exact 32/35 boundary issue to Stage A rather than silently coercing it.
The semantic_change=NO folds for Article 15(2), Article 6(2), Article 7(1), and Article 15(1) retain verbatim-equivalent source text and do not cross a semantic change.
unresolved: The attached corpus does not state the start event for D.lgs. 19/2021 Article 33(1)'s special 'entro quarantacinque giorni' authorization period. Stage B anchors it on lodging the landscape-authorization application, while the reached Article 146 rows separately state a 45-day superintendent-opinion period from receipt of the acts; without an explicit producer-span start rule, the exact Article 33(1) anchor cannot be resolved without reopening Stage A or consulting an out-of-scope source.
